featuresPage.seoTitle: Features – software for kids' bazaars, bike sales and flea markets | BazarPro
featuresPage.seoDescription: Seller registration, QR labels, smartphone checkout with a cart, automatic settlement and email reminders: all features for clothing bazaars, bike sales and flea markets.
featuresPage.title: Everything for your bazaar – <highlight>in one app</highlight>
featuresPage.intro: From seller registration to checkout to payout: BazarPro replaces paper lists, handwritten labels and counting cash in the evening.

wizard.title: Your bazaar in eight steps
wizard.text: Pick a bike sale, kids' bazaar or flea market: the wizard presets suitable settings and explains each step. At the end you see the conditions exactly as sellers will.

qrLabels.title: QR labels in two sizes
qrLabels.text: Sellers print their own labels: large for bikes, small with 40 per page for clothes, always with the seller number. Without a price on them, discounts work without reprinting.

phoneCheckout.title: Checkout with a cart
phoneCheckout.text: Scan all items of a buyer and take payment once – with the phone camera in the browser or a hand scanner. No till or app needed.

settlement.title: Settlement at the push of a button
settlement.text: Sales, commission, intake fee and payout are settled for every seller – no lists, no recounting.

live.title: Sellers always in the loop
live.text: Sellers see live what has sold. The evening before they get the drop-off details, after the bazaar a pickup reminder – and you reach everyone with one message.

registration.title: Registration under control
registration.text: Access code, participant limit, items per seller and required details like the frame number. Sellers see the fees upfront with a worked example.

negotiate.title: Haggle like at a flea market
negotiate.text: Buyers send price offers online, or the checkout sells down to the minimum price the seller has set.

proof.title: Records for the police
proof.text: For bike markets that need records: private sellers only, frame number required, data fixed from registration – and a list of all bikes offered as PDF or CSV.

languages.title: German and English
languages.text: The app and its emails are available in German and English. Everyone gets emails in their own language.

useCases.title: For every second-hand bazaar
useCases.text: Wherever sellers drop off their things and a team sells them. When you create a bazaar, you pick its kind and BazarPro presets suitable settings.

kids.title: Children's clothing bazaar
kids.text: Clothing, kids' or numbered bazaar: many small items, small labels, photos optional.

bikes.title: Bike sale
bikes.text: Bike exchange or bike market: frame number on every bike, negotiable prices and, if needed, records for the police.

toys.title: Toy bazaar
toys.text: Toys, books and baby gear, with questions to the seller for bigger items.

ski.title: Ski and winter sports bazaar
ski.text: Skis, boots and helmets with size and brand, discounts towards the end of the day.

fleaMarket.title: Second-hand flea market
fleaMarket.text: Few rules, price offers and discounts – for club, school or parish flea markets.

books.title: Book flea market
books.text: Many single items without photos, entered quickly and sold in one cart at the checkout.

free.question: Is BazarPro really free?
free.answer: Yes. All features are free for organizers, sellers and visitors – no subscription, no trial period and no limit on bazaars or sellers.

useCases.question: Which bazaars is BazarPro for?
useCases.answer: For every bazaar where sellers drop off their things and a team sells them: children's clothing and clothing bazaars, toy bazaars, bike sales, ski and winter sports bazaars and flea markets. When you create a bazaar, you pick its kind and BazarPro presets suitable settings.

commission.question: Does BazarPro earn money from my bazaar?
commission.answer: No. You set the commission you keep from the sales as an organizer yourself – and all of it stays with you.

hardware.question: Do I need a till or a scanner?
hardware.answer: No. Drop-off and sales run in the browser using the camera of a smartphone or tablet. You can also use a hand scanner at the checkout. You print labels on regular paper.

selfHost.question: Can I run BazarPro on my own server?
selfHost.answer: Yes. BazarPro is open source under the MIT license. With Docker Compose it runs on your own server – the guide is in the documentation at docs.bazarpro.de.
